name: hf-disturbed-long-alarm-noise-control
purpose: One predeclared ordinary noise-only negative control after the two paired long raw-bit histories (four receive rows). Use hf-disturbed seed 9602, C/N0 12 dB-Hz, requested 128-second bits, message e, CPU/reference/RRC, Helper/FEC off, default automatic workers, no filters or raw-repeat controls, and the same 4,350,000-sample/180-second caps. The native message fixture has three DATA bits and five scored slots. Require complete valid quiet observations and no DATA decisions to support the absence-control expectation; retain any unexpected admission as evidence without retries.
